openings.claim: Reconcile revision state before quantity comparison: recency cannot establish replacement identity. Preserve sixty rows, link only explicit superseded references, compare effective times with cutoffs, and normalize only U=5V; equal quantities across identifiers are candidate equivalence, never proof.
openings.discriminator: Against latest-report-wins, the ledger should expose the awkward replacement as supported identity or bounded disagreement with fewer unsupported definite claims; missing references and undefined statuses propagate uncertainty without erasing rows.
openings.probe: Within sixty minutes produce twelve cited outcomes and annotate rival choices on amendment-linked and duplicate rows. Freeze outputs; in the supplied twenty-minute comparison use the sealed key to score resolutions, unsupported claims, and requests. Defeat: equal/greater unsupported claims or no distinct rival choices. Account for sixty rows and eight amendments; unfinished analysis becomes explicit disagreement.
openings.uncertainty: Explicit references and the supplied dictionary may support identity; absent references or undefined codes do not. No neighboring-batch imputation or additional conversion. Timing remains unmeasured; effects are synthetic proposals.

openings.claim: Map unresolved batches to exact missing fields/records and select at most three requests by shared evidence dependencies; retain cited bounded disagreements for uncovered batches.
openings.discriminator: Compared with requesting the first three unresolved batches, shared-dependency selection should cover more batches per request only when gaps actually overlap.
openings.probe: Using the frozen D1 ledger, enumerate both request sets during the supplied comparison period and count batches whose named gaps each covers. Test coverage, not resolution. Defeat: no shared gaps or no coverage advantage. Each request must name concrete missing evidence; undefined-code meaning cannot be invented.
openings.uncertainty: Shared gaps are possible, not observed; follow-up replies are unavailable. Timing feasibility is unverified.
